text:
Mae Park: quick heads-up — planning an incremental client contract change for the JS/Python SDKs tonight. small optional field addition (request.metadata.client_version). aiming for a canary then gradual ramp. who can own the deploy window?
Devin Cole: I can run the deploy. prefer 23:00 PT. will do canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~45m.
Sanjay Iyer: is the new field strictly additive? any behaviour change if older client sends null/missing?
Mae Park: yes additive only, runtime should ignore missing keys. server schema will accept missing metadata. we added a compatibility test in integration-suite.
Elena Rojas: ops: 23:00 PT works for the cluster with lowest traffic. I'll be on-call for smoke checks and rollback.
Priya Nair: client comms: I'll draft a short note saying "minor opt-in telemetry/metadata field; no action required". want to include migration snippet.
Devin Cole: checklist for deploy:
```
1) tag release: release/patch-client-contract-2165
2) push server canary image: inference:prod-2165-canary
3) run smoke script: scripts/smoke_contract_check.sh --canary
4) monitor latency/errors for 15m
```
Devin Cole: I can handle 1-3. @Elena please run the smoke script and confirm traces.
Elena Rojas: running smoke now on canary... logs look clean so far. no 5xxs, p50/p95 stable.
ops-bot: Deploy window reserved by @Devin Cole for 2165-03-17 23:00 PT. SLA: standard.
Sanjay Iyer: two quick asks: (1) what's rollback procedure exactly? (2) will dedicated customers get a separate opt-out flag?
Elena Rojas: rollback = promote previous image tag (inference:prod-2164) + invalidate new cache entries. command: `kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=inference:prod-2164 -n redwood-prod` then restart router pods.
Mae Park: for dedicated customers we'll not flip the flag automatically. need per-tenant rollout; ops will coordinate with account owners.
Priya Nair: I'll send a short email to account owners and add note in changelog + SDK release notes. draft ready — reviewing now.
Devin Cole: will run canary at 23:00 PT, watch errors + rollout metrics. ping here when I promote to 50%.
Elena Rojas: smoke after canary passed: run `scripts/smoke_contract_check.sh --full` and check `client-contract-regressions` dashboard.
Devin Cole: canary done :white_check_mark: no regressions, latency ok. promoting to 50%.
deploy-bot: Promotion to 50% started by @Devin Cole. Jobs queued: canary->50%.
Sanjay Iyer: please also verify client telemetry toggles — if customers complain we can flip `metadata_opt_in=false` globally for concerned tenants.
Mae Park: noted. Priya, include opt-out steps in comms.
Priya Nair: will do. sending comms after GA.
Devin Cole: promoted to 50% :white_check_mark: holding 20m, then final ramp if metrics stable.
Elena Rojas: standby on rollback commands in case alerts spike. I have runbooks open.
Devin Cole: 100% promoted. all healthy. closing loop: no breaking changes, clients unaffected.
Mae Park: thanks everyone — follow-up actions: Priya sends comms, Sanjay double-checks regression suite for nightly, Elena files a short post-deploy note, Devin closes the release PR. good job. :tada:
